state.faq_question: What is the maximum file size I can upload?
state.canonical_answer: The maximum upload size is 500 MB per file on all paid plans, and 100 MB on the free plan.

passages.text: Files larger than 100 MB will be rejected. This limit applies to every account, regardless of plan.
Paid subscribers can upload files up to 500 MB each; free accounts are capped at 100 MB.
To upload a file, click the paperclip icon in the toolbar and select your file.
